This '''holocron''' was a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] that was created by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Elcho Kressh]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. In it, Kressh detailed a plan that he had enacted to establish an [[Army/Legends|army]] by forming alliances with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the [[Republic Dark Age]], the holocron was discovered by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Mandragall]]. Mandragall eventually became the ruler of a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], and found himself without sufficient forces to defend his territories from rival Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lords]], so he consulted Kressh's holocron and followed to the letter Kressh's plan on how to create an army of independent operators.
